contract.flexion: unsigned geometric bend magnitude in degrees, range 0..180
contract.orientation: fixture convention scored using one fixed proper mapping per hand side; raw production frame is not overwritten
contract.proximal: angle(wrist -> finger base, finger base -> next joint); geometric proxy, not isolated clinical MCP flexion
contract.spread: unsigned angle between actual proximal-phalanx directions projected into the output-geometry palm plane

qa_contract.rule: valid_palm_frame gates orientation; valid flexion/spread channels are evaluated independently and undefined channels are NaN
